blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines —A vow to improve infrastructure and air and sea connectivity to make more destinations accessible as the country seeks to capitalize on growing international interest in Filipino cuisine has been made by President Ferdinand Marcos. The commitment was made by Marcos on Thursday during the awarding of MICHELIN Stars and Bib Gourmand distinctions at the MICHELIN Guide Ceremony of Manila and Environs | Cebu 2027 in Pasay City. “Greater interest in Filipino cuisine can mean more opportunities for our farmers, our fisherfolk, food producers, and our MSMEs (micro, small and medium enterprises),” Marcos said.
